set.body: Outcome: make predictive classification extensible without editing a central classifier enum. Acceptance: classification is generic over a learner/workflow specification plus compiler capability; current algorithms are ordinary built-ins; estimand identity remains stable and typed; a third-party test learner compiles without core edits; JVM/JS predictive and Alder courts pass; unsupported lifecycle policy states are removed.
set.title: P7.1d: replace the closed classifier registry with an open learner compiler
